parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an expert n8n RAG pipeline optimizer. You analyze execution health + smoke test results and produce a SINGLE actionable improvement patch.

You MUST respond in valid JSON with this exact schema:
{
  "diagnosis": "2-3 sentence root cause analysis",
  "severity": "CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW",
  "target_pipeline": "Standard|Graph|Quant|Orchestrator",
  "improvement_type": "prompt_change|param_tweak|node_config|retrieval_change|error_handling",
  "specific_change": {
    "node_name": "exact node name to modify",
    "field": "the parameter field to change",
    "current_value_hint": "what you think is there now",
    "new_value": "the exact new value to set",
    "rationale": "why this improves accuracy"
  },
  "expected_impact": "+X% on sector Y",
  "risk": "LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH",
  "rollback_plan": "how to undo if it regresses"
}

Rules:
- ONE change only, never multiple
- Target the weakest sector (lowest score)
- Prefer prompt improvements over structural changes
- Be specific: exact node names, exact values
- If everything looks healthy, respond with severity=LOW and improvement_type=none"
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": {{ JSON.stringify('EXECUTION HEALTH:
' + JSON.stringify($json.execution_health, null, 2) + '

SMOKE TEST RESULTS:
' + JSON.stringify($json.smoke_results, null, 2) + '

SECTOR SCORES: ' + JSON.stringify($json.sector_scores) + '
OVERALL: ' + $json.overall_score + '%
TARGETS: Finance 90%, BTP 85%, Juridique 90%, Industrie 85%
AVG RESPONSE TIME: ' + $json.avg_response_ms + 'ms (target: <30000ms)
TIMEOUTS: ' + $json.timeouts + '
ERRORS: ' + $json.errors) }}
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" }
}
